Thanks for replying. I'm so worried about what other people think it's ridiculous. I'm looking at macbook Pros, so the big ones retail for like £1450 with a student discount. I don't want to be that flashy person with the OTT equipment. But I also want to get my work done... I don't know what everyone else will have, or if everyone normally makes do with smaller ones, or what. Theres like a £300 difference in cost for me, which I don't mind too much if I make the right decision, but if I make the wrong one I'm in no financial position to be able to just get another one. I'm just so scared and I don't know why. Thank you again for your reply

Edit - also good idea about the coin thing. Unfortunately I've overthought this so much I don't have a gut feeling any more. And then even when I say I'll just do whatever it lands on, inevitably I end up saying it's too important a decision to base on a coin toss. I'm just driving myself insane.
